description: Interactive world map: total number of international immigrants in 2024, with the flows between selected countries (people born in one country and living in the other). Source: UN DESA, International Migrant Stock 2024.

text.signal: width < 450 ? 'International immigrants, 2024' : 'Total number of international immigrants 2024'

subtitle.signal: width < 450 ? 'Click two or more countries' : 'Click two or more countries to see how many people born in one live in the other'

on.update: [clamp(panStart[0] + x() - down[0], -(zoom - 1) * width / 2 - 40, (zoom - 1) * width / 2 + 40), clamp(panStart[1] + y() - down[1], -(zoom - 1) * height / 2 - 40, (zoom - 1) * height / 2 + 40)]
moved ? picked : (indexof(picked, ',' + datum.id + ',') >= 0 ? replace(picked, ',' + datum.id + ',', ',') : picked + datum.id + ',')

title.signal: width < 450 ? 'Number of immigrants' : 'Number of immigrants (people living in a country they were not born in)'
